$comment: Track B credit tiers (PRD §credit system). Configurable — the platform copy of this config lives in the trackb_config WorkspaceDB row 'credits' and overrides these defaults at runtime. Costs are per operation; ranges express the configurable envelope, 'default' is what is charged until the founder tunes it.
$comment_expensive: Any operation with cost >= expensive_threshold must show its credit cost to the customer BEFORE execution.
$comment_failed: A failed operation that produces no billable work must never deduct credits. Deductions settle only on confirmed success; failures void the reservation.

regeneration_budget.$comment: escalation_threshold = consecutive failed regeneration attempts after which the agent must stop and escalate to a human instead of looping.
